source: Token & turn analysis of the October 23 trajectory export (token-analysis/REPORT.md, runs.csv, submissions.csv).
scope: Latest cohort per task: 25 tasks, 152 runs. Values are per-model medians across tasks.

definitions.first_valid: The first submission that the private Judge marked valid and scored.
definitions.hours: Wall-clock hours from run start to that submission.
definitions.tool_calls: Agent tool calls made before that submission, counted from the trajectory.
definitions.tokens: Input + output tokens consumed before that submission, from per-request usage records (n = runs with exact records).
definitions.tokens_per_run: All tokens consumed over the whole 12–24 h run.
definitions.first_try_valid: Runs whose first submission was already valid and scored.

provenance.claude: Exact: per-request usage in the stream-json trajectory, with output tokens rebuilt from the CLI's own estimates (within ±3% on 10 runs with final usage records).
provenance.qwen: Exact when one run used the model relay alone; pro-rated across concurrent runs otherwise.
provenance.deepseek: Exact when one run used the model relay alone; pro-rated across concurrent runs otherwise.
provenance.glm: Exact when one run used the model relay alone; pro-rated across concurrent runs otherwise.
provenance.sol: No per-request records (direct API). Whole-run totals are estimated from the median tokens per tool call.
provenance.astra: No per-request records for most runs (direct API). Whole-run totals are estimated from the median tokens per tool call.
